title: YLX final actual variance readback receipt v1
description: Immutable external exact-byte readback receipt for one published FINAL_ACTUAL_VARIANCE bundle F. It exact-references the unique unrevisioned publication receipt P, whose digest already binds the exact F, post-F pre-action evaluation, publisher identity, complete publisher task actual and variance, and durability result. R repeats only the target tuple needed to prove exact F readback, avoiding a second malleable copy of P's execution tuple. It records observation only and grants no planning, milestone, signoff, release-completion, terminal-slot, or distribution authority.

receipt_id.description: Deterministic ID equal to 'final-actual-variance-readback-' plus lowercase SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JSON UTF-8 over an object containing exactly publication_receipt_ref, final_bundle_ref, and final_bundle_sha256 from this receipt. publication_receipt_ref is a closed unrevisioned exact-byte reference to P, so its digest transitively binds P's complete execution and publisher-actual tuple without duplicating it here. Procedural validation recomputes the digest and permits exactly one effective receipt for this preimage.

publication_receipt_ref.description: Exact four-field unrevisioned artifact reference to P. Revision is forbidden. Procedural validation dereferences these exact receipt bytes and requires publication_receipt_ref.artifact_id to equal P.receipt_id.

final_bundle_ref.description: Exact reference to F. It must equal the final_bundle_ref in P and resolve to the accepted FINAL_ACTUAL_VARIANCE bundle named by the publisher closure.

final_bundle_sha256.description: Expected lowercase SHA-256 of F's exact RFC 8785 JSON UTF-8 bytes. It must equal P.final_bundle_sha256, final_bundle_ref.artifact_sha256, observed_final_bundle_sha256, and the digest embedded in final_bundle_locator.

final_bundle_locator.description: Canonical content-addressed target path read back for F. It must equal P.final_bundle_locator and final_bundle_ref.artifact_path exactly.

final_bundle_byte_length.description: Expected byte length of F's exact RFC 8785 JSON UTF-8 bytes. It must equal P.final_bundle_byte_length and observed_final_bundle_byte_length.

observed_final_bundle_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 computed from the exact bytes read back from final_bundle_locator.

observed_final_bundle_byte_length.description: Observed byte length of the exact bytes read back from final_bundle_locator.

read_back_at.description: Time the exact target bytes were observed. Procedural validation requires P.publisher_task_actual.actual_finished_at equal P.published_at and P.published_at strictly before read_back_at.

publicationReceiptRef.description: Exact reference to an immutable unrevisioned final-actual-variance publication receipt; revision is forbidden.
